descriptorInput: node.label + '. ' + each of the two independently authored positiveDescriptions
descriptorPair: same descriptor vector in both input fields, passed through the declared paired-input adapter
titleInput: existing retained public title, bounded to 512 UTF-16 units without splitting a surrogate pair
bodyInput: existing normalized public Source embedding, binary64 wire and JSON mirror exactly equal
labels: blind title/host metadata partial gold sealed before model initialization; unknown names are insufficient, not negatives
evaluation: root ranking on explicit metadata roots only; deeper body predictions are not errors merely because the title annotation is partial
